text: Senzo Mchunu: Mr Mchunu has since denied what he says are "wild allegations"
Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi: The provincial police chief also alleged Mr Mchunu had ties to a controversial businessman who was "financially supporting" the minister's political career.

Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi: Gen Mkhwanazi detailed a sequence of events he claims led to the "orchestrated" disbandment of a task force set up in 2018 to investigate the killing of politicians, mainly in KwaZulu-Natal.
It is thought that the shooting has connections to organized crime.
